newsitem.title: USA: Manitowoc posts record $145 mln backlog.
newsitem.headline: Manitowoc posts record $145 mln backlog.

text.p: Manitowoc Co Inc, reporting improved third-quarter results, said a record backlog of $145 million is a positive indicator for future business.

"Not only has our backlog grown by nearly $54 million since the end of the second quarter, every unit within our crane segment has contributed to this gain," said president Fred Butler in a statement.
Butler said the company's crane segment continued productivity improvements during the quarter.
Manitowoc reported third-quarter earnings rose to $0.74 per share from $0.31 a year ago. Sales climbed to $132.0 million from $80.1 million.
